author: BmB
body:
Hey I was told by a trusty mod to report this on the forums, he had a really perky asshole named josh. 
So, spookz basically had this client that he used to toggle in important gaems. 
He told me he toggled in certain fights and that it was nothing major.
I really think this needs to be addressed as he is a well known competitive pvpman and should probably be stopped before he wins a tournament (lul) 
Thanks
